methods.name: Traditional Qi Refinement
methods.desc: Meditate, accumulate Qi, force bottlenecks. The baseline every other path is measured against.

methods.name: Body Tempering Art
methods.desc: Cultivation comes from surviving conditioning, not sitting. Gains scale with STR and pain.

methods.name: Sword Heart Method
methods.desc: Sword intent accrued through duels and practice. Meditation alone does almost nothing.

methods.name: Blood Sea Scripture
methods.desc: Absorb compatible blood essence from supernatural creatures. Fast, and it changes you.

methods.name: Slaughter Dao
methods.desc: Every kill feeds the dao. Tribulations grow heavier with every corpse behind you.

methods.name: Dual Cultivation
methods.desc: Progress through mutual circulation with a compatible partner. Relationships are the resource.

methods.name: Heavenly Star Absorption
methods.desc: Draw on stellar alignments and rare celestial materials during specific windows.

methods.name: Beast Companion Path
methods.desc: Cultivation shared with bonded beasts and summoned spirits. Sitting alone is half a path; sitting among your pack is the whole of it.

methods.name: Pillfire Alchemy
methods.risk: a furnace fed on pills starves without them
methods.desc: The furnace is stocked, not stoked: meditation draws on the pills you carry, and a full pouch steadies even a tribulation.

methods.name: Five Phases Cycle
methods.desc: Wood feeds fire, fire feeds earth: the cycle turns with the land itself. Phase-rich ground sings; ash and sand silence it.

methods.name: Stillness Formation
methods.risk: a broken array is worse than none
methods.desc: The body becomes the array: breath, posture and patience laid out like flags. The longer the stillness holds unbroken, the deeper it draws.

methods.name: Heaven-Defying Scripture
methods.desc: Taint is fuel. The scripture burns contamination for progress and cleans the meridians as it feeds - but Heaven keeps the ledger, and tribulations come heavier.
